applicability_conditions: Policy must contain owner-driver personal accident cover
Death must be due to a motor accident involving the insured vehicle
Accident must occur within policy period and geographical limits

required_documents.label: Motor policy with owner-driver PA cover section
Valid driving license of owner-driver at time of accident

conditional_documents.label: Nominee/legal heir proof
conditional_documents.condition: If owner-driver PA benefit is payable to nominee

conditional_documents.label: Vehicle registration certificate (RC)
conditional_documents.condition: If required by insurer for vehicle verification

note: A standard motor policy is not automatically a death-benefit policy. Only owner-driver personal accident cover (if included) may provide a death benefit. Verify with the insurer.
